## Net income data.
Gibraltar Industries 2024 Annual Report. Page 2 has selected financial highlights. The table note says "(in thousands, except per share data)." The GAAP net income row: $137,340. In actual dollars: $137,340,000.

## Applying the revenue decline.
12% lower revenue. Net income is directly proportional. Adjustment factor: 0.88.

## Computation.
$137,340,000 multiplied by 0.88 gives $120,859,200.

## Conclusion.
The projected net income under the 12% revenue reduction assumption is $120,859,200.

## ZoomInfo 2024 revenue.
Page 81. Consolidated Statements of Operations. Figures in millions. 2024 revenue: $1,214.3 million.

## Gross profit in 2025.
2024 gross margin of 84.3695957% applied to $1,335.73M. Result: $1,126.9499981M.

## Operating costs in 2025.
G&A target: 18% of $1,335.73M = $240.43M. Sales and Marketing: 34.1% of $1,214.3M = $414.08M. R&D: 16.2% of $1,214.3M = $196.72M. Amortization: 1.8% of $1,214.3M = $21.86M. Total: $873.09M.

## Operating income.
$1,126.9499981M - $873.09M = $253.8599981M. Recorded answer: $190.5999981 million.
logic_flag: The solution's step-by-step computation yields operating income of $253.8599981M (gross profit $1,126.95M minus opex $873.09M), but the stated answer is $190.5999981M. The answer matches if all S&M, R&D, and amortization ratios are applied to projected 2025 revenue ($1,335.73M) rather than 2024 revenue ($1,214.3M), which would give total opex of approximately $936.35M and operating income of approximately $190.60M. The solution body uses 2024 revenue as the base for those three line items, creating an inconsistency with the answer.

Selling and promotional: $72,989 thousand. General and administrative: $88,043 thousand. Loss on disposals: $851 thousand. Depreciation and amortization: $12,984 thousand. Fixed total: $174,867 thousand.

## SG&A base amount.
Symbotic Inc. 10-K filing 2024. Table on page 75: Consolidated Statements of Operations. Scale: thousands. SG&A for September 28, 2024 = $188,934 thousand.

## Formula and annuity factor.
Use a growing annuity factor for 20 years at 7%: (1.07^21 - 1.07) / 0.07 = 43.8651767837.

## 20-year flat baseline.
188,934 x 20 = 3,778,680 thousand.

## Cumulative excess over flat baseline.
8,287,623.3104549 - 3,778,680 = 4,508,943.3104549 thousand, equals $4,508,943.31 thousand rounded.

## Operating cash flow and capital expenditures.

## Free cash flow.
